name: egm-product
description: AI-native Product Management framework on the Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM): product, role & UI shell discovery, JTBD + User Story opportunity shaping, PRDs with built-in 4+1 product review, and zero-build HTML prototypes inside the real product canvas.
suggestedPrompts: Run /pm-discover to map our product context, user roles, UI shell, and metric tree
Run /pm-brainstorm to shape Jobs-to-be-Done and challenge a new feature idea
Run /pm-prd to draft and review a JTBD + User Story PRD

interface.longDescription: Adapts the Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) for Product Managers: capture company context, empirical user roles, App Shell UI blueprints, and product metric trees; shape Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) and cut MVP bloat with the 4+1 Product Goldfish swarm; draft and review JTBD + User Story PRDs without backend noise; and build zero-build interactive HTML prototypes inside the real product UI canvas.
capabilities: Map product strategy, empirical user roles, UI shell, and metrics
Challenge Jobs-to-be-Done and MVP scope with 4+1 Product Goldfish critics
Draft and polish JTBD + User Story PRDs with built-in review
Generate zero-build HTML prototypes inside the real product UI canvas
defaultPrompt: Discover our product context, roles, UI shell, and metric tree
Brainstorm Jobs-to-be-Done and cut MVP bloat
Draft and review a JTBD + User Story PRD
Generate an interactive HTML prototype inside our product UI
